The '''Simus Minor Belt''' was an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] occupying the fourth [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] in the [[Simus Minor system]], which was located on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Rogue One">''{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040122threat|text=Triplet Threat|int=Triplet Threat}}''</ref>
